row: BLOWN jet-flap NACA 0012 with trailing-edge slot. C_mu_jet = 0.05, alpha = 0 deg, tau = 30 deg (jet deflection below the chord line), Re_c = 1.0e6, c = 1 m, U_inf = 10 m/s, nu = 1.0e-05 m2/s, h/c = 0.005. simpleFoam steady incompressible kOmegaSST low-Re, OpenFOAM v2606, serial.
jet_bcs_derived_not_transcribed: V_j = U_inf sqrt(C_mu_jet / (2 h/c)) = 22.360680 m/s. U_jetSlot = V_j (cos tau, -sin tau, 0) = (19.36491673, -11.18033989, 0) m/s, FIXED IN THE AIRFOIL FRAME and NOT rotated with alpha (frozen sections 5.1 and 1.6a, amendment A3). k_jet = max(1.5 (I V_j)^2, k_inf) with I = 0.01 = 7.5000000000e-02 m2/s2. omega_jet = max(sqrt(k_jet)/(C_mu_turb^0.25 l_j), omega_inf) with C_mu_turb = 0.09 THE MODEL CONSTANT (never the jet coefficient -- frozen section 0 records that the directive collides the two symbols and that reading it as C_mu_jet divides by zero at the unblown point) and l_j = 0.07 h = 3.5e-04 m = 1428.571429 1/s. THE max(...) FLOORS ARE PRESENT IN THE DICTIONARIES AND WERE CHECKED, which is what amendment A10 exists for: without them the unblown point gives k = omega = 0, frozen section 7.4 binds omega > 0, and omega = 0 in a kOmegaSST inlet is a division by zero in nut = k/omega. On this blown row the floors are INERT (1.5(I V_j)^2 exceeds k_inf by >= 500x), so these values reproduce the frozen section 5.2 table to every printed digit. THE LAUNCHER RE-DERIVES ALL THREE FROM THE FORMULAE AT RUN TIME AND REFUSES (exit 3) IF ITS SUBSTITUTED CONSTANTS DO NOT REPRODUCE THEM -- a transcription error is a refusal, not a silently wrong jet.
slot_is_a_patch_and_the_unblown_run_is_N: jetSlot is built as polyMesh type `patch` (build_jf1.py --slot-type patch) with U fixedValue, k fixedValue, omega fixedValue, nut calculated, p zeroGradient -- the frozen section 5.1 wall set. DISCLOSED DEPARTURE FOUND BY THIS LANE, REPORTED RATHER THAN QUIETLY FIXED: frozen section 5.2a registers 'jetSlot is a `patch` on EVERY row of the sweep, with the same BC types on every row, and only the numeric values change', and gives the reason -- changing the patch type mid-sweep changes the momentum/k/omega BCs, the forceCoeffs patch set and the checkMesh topology, so a reference computed on a different BC family is not a reference for the map. The UNBLOWN feasibility run launched at 2026-08-31T15:40:37Z used --slot-type wall with noSlip and forceCoeffs patches (airfoil jetSlot). IT IS THEREFORE NOT A MEMBER OF THIS FAMILY AND CANNOT SERVE AS THE FROZEN SECTION 1.1 UNBLOWN REFERENCE. That costs nothing here (both are feasibility and score nothing) but a gated unblown reference must be rebuilt with --slot-type patch and the floored BCs at C_mu = 0.
forceCoeffs_patch_set: patches (airfoil) ONLY, which is the frozen registration's own dictionary (JF1_PREREGISTRATION.md:1192, 'jetSlot is NOT a wall and is NOT included'). Including jetSlot would put the jet's own pressure force into CL_aero and double-count it against the explicit jet-reaction term of CL_total = CL_aero + C_mu_jet sin(tau + alpha). Aref = c x span = 0.01, NOT 1.0: forceCoeffs integrates over the real 0.01 m span of the one-cell-thick mesh and Aref = 1.0 would report CL and Cd 100x too small (forceCoeffs.C:164 reads Aref verbatim and its guard at :328 catches only a MISSING or zero value, never a wrong one).
